core.title: Propeller Steel Shutter Dogs, Acorn AK6BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AK6BQ, 7" Propeller Steel Shutter Dogs

Available in for brick and wood installation, Acorn's Propeller Steel Shutter Dogs are designed to hold open window shutters. They are both functional and beautiful, adding classic charm to your home with a simple installation. Sold in pairs--one for each shutter--they are packaged with aluminum anti-rattle hooks, stainless steel fasteners, and anchors for brick mounting. The matte black finish is perfect accent for traditional homes.

Specifications and Features of the Propeller Steel Shutter Dogs:

  • Material: Steel.
  • Finish: Black
  • Length: 7"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Stainless Steel Lag Screw: 4" x 3/8"
  • Comes packaged with 2 shutter dogs, 2 lag screws, and 2 aluminum anti-rattle hooks. Anchors are supplied for Brick Application Shutter Dogs.

Priced and sold in pairs (2 shutter dogs).
